name: The Agent Wall
description: Claim a tile for an AI agent, tool, or workflow. Buyers get permanent discovery space and can update their destination while ownership remains fixed.

name: The Launch Grid
eyebrow: The front page for products born in 2026.
description: A finite launch board where every tile belongs to one product launched this year. Visitors browse by week, category, and momentum.

name: The Open Source Wall
eyebrow: Sponsor the software the internet runs on.
description: Projects claim free identity tiles; sponsors fund highlighted space around them. The public wall routes attention and money toward maintainers.

name: The 2036 Time Capsule
description: Individuals and brands seal a public tile now. Its full message unlocks in 2036 while a short teaser remains visible today.

name: The Local Mosaic
eyebrow: One city. Ten thousand independent places.
description: Each storefront tile belongs to a real independent business. Visitors explore a city through a visual mosaic rather than a ranked directory.

name: The Creator Atlas
eyebrow: Find people by what they make, not follower count.
description: Creators own one finite tile linked to their best work. Discovery rotates by craft, language, and location instead of popularity alone.

name: The Human Skills Map
eyebrow: A finite atlas of things humans can do.
description: Experts claim tiles for rare, useful, or beautiful skills. Each tile links to proof, teaching, or a booking destination.

name: The Climate Action Grid
description: Organizations fund a tile by publishing a measurable action with evidence and a review date. Stale claims visibly expire.

name: The Internet Museum Wall
eyebrow: Own a small piece of web history.
description: A curated finite mosaic commemorating protocols, communities, artifacts, memes, and tools that shaped online culture.

name: The Future Work Wall
eyebrow: Ten thousand roles people are inventing now.
description: Teams and individuals claim tiles for emerging roles, publish what the work actually involves, and link to real opportunities or learning paths.
